title: A map that is C¹ on an open neighbourhood of a compact set agrees near it with a globally Lipschitz C¹ map
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, K ⊆ ℝ^P compact, O ⊆ ℝ^P open with K ⊆ O, and f : ℝ^P → ℝ^P of class C¹ on O (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O; no assumption on f off O). Then there are g : ℝ^P → ℝ^P of class C¹ on all of ℝ^P (ContDiff ℝ 1 g) and L ∈ ℝ≥0 such that g is L-Lipschitz on ℝ^P and, for every x ∈ K, g(x) = f(x) and Dg(x) = Df(x) (fderiv ℝ g x = fderiv ℝ f x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (K O : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsCompact K → IsOpen O → K ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O → ∃ (g : Euclid P → Euclid P) (L : NNReal), ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ LipschitzWith L g ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, g x = f x ∧ fderiv ℝ g x = fderiv ℝ f x
